name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: State Department revokes visa of Brazil's ambassador to the U.S.
changes.summary: A senior State Department official said the visa would be reinstated immediately if Brazil grants diplomatic approval for President Trump's nominee for U.S. ambassador to Brazil, Daniel Perez.

changes.title: Trump administration revokes Brazilian ambassador’s visa in diplomatic dispute
changes.summary: The Trump administration revoked the visa of Brazil’s U.S. ambassador Tuesday — the latest jab in a monthslong diplomatic spat between the two countries.

changes.title: Democratic Rep. Gluesenkamp Perez and Trump-backed Republican advance in Washington's 3rd District primary
changes.summary: Democratic Rep. Marie Gluesenkamp Perez and Republican state Sen. John Braun will advance to a general election in Washington's 3rd District, one of the most hotly contested House contests of this year, CBS News projects.

changes.title: John James wins Michigan Republican gubernatorial primary, CBS News projects
changes.summary: U.S. Rep. John James, endorsed by President Trump, is projected to be the winner of Tuesday's Republican gubernatorial primary race in Michigan, according to CBS News.

changes.title: Rick Brattin wins Republican primary for Missouri seat redrawn to favor GOP
changes.summary: Trump-endorsed Rick Brattin won the GOP primary for Missouri's 5th Congressional District, CBS News projects, setting up a battle against an 11-term Democrat in a district that was made far more GOP-leaning.

changes.title: Trump-backed John James wins Michigan’s GOP primary for governor
changes.summary: Rep. John James has won Michigan’s Republican nomination for governor, NBC News projects.

changes.title: Inside the Oval Office Showdown Between Trump and Jeanine Pirro
changes.summary: Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney for the District of Columbia, told President Trump that his interior secretary, Doug Burgum, had misled him with a self-serving cover story for his own mistakes.

changes.title: Trump-backed Ty Masterson wins Republican nomination for Kansas governor
changes.summary: NBC News projects that Masterson, the state Senate president, emerged from the primary in a contest that represents a top pickup opportunity for the GOP this fall.

changes.title: Pirro Meets With Trump at the White House After He Said She ‘Choked’ in Reflecting Pool Case
changes.summary: President Trump said Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney for Washington, D.C., “folded like an umbrella.” For now, her job appeared to be safe, according to two people familiar with the meeting.

changes.title: They're a world leader in using drones for healthcare. But drones can't do it all
changes.summary: Drones carrying medical supplies constantly crisscross the skies of Rwanda. The Trump administration is giving a major grant to the effort — and at the same time cutting aid to the country. (Image credit: Claire Harbage/NPR).
